# Asia Tech Review Bulletin

> A regularly updated public feed of curated Asia technology news, covering startups, venture capital, policy and regional tech ecosystems.

Prefer the versioned API or JSON Feed for structured ingestion instead of scraping the visual website. Use `source_url` as the primary citation for each bulletin item.

## Feeds & API

- [Latest structured items](https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/api/v1/items): Recent bulletin items with structured fields, categories and metadata.
- [JSON Feed](https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/feed.json): JSON feed of recent items for simple ingestion.
- [OpenAPI schema](https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/api/openapi.json): Machine-readable API specification covering query parameters, item lookup, categories and search.
- [Versioned API root](https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/api/v1): Base endpoint for v1 API resources.
- [Public API index](https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/api): Overview of public API routes.

## Optional

- [RSS/XML feed](https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/rss.xml): XML syndication feed for feed readers.
- [Public website](https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/): Website for browsing the Bulletin.
